column1: A whole slide image of chromophobe renal cell carcinoma (KICH) at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of solid sheets and nests of tumor cells, distinct cellular borders, broad fibrous septa subdividing tumor lobules, and an overall pale or eosinophilic tinctorial appearance against a relatively uniform tumor architecture.

A whole slide image of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (KIRC) at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of expansile tumor nodules with prominent thin-walled vasculature forming a delicate network, hemorrhagic and yellow-tinged cut surfaces, alveolar and acinar growth patterns, and frequent areas of necrosis or cystic degeneration.

A whole slide image of papillary renal cell carcinoma (KIRP) at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of organized papillary architecture with fibrovascular cores, tubulopapillary growth patterns, frequent foamy macrophages within the papillae, psammomatous calcifications, and a fibrous pseudocapsule separating tumor from adjacent kidney.

A whole slide image of chromophobe renal cell carcinoma (KICH) at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of large polygonal tumor cells with sharply defined cell membranes (plant-cell-like outlines), pale or finely reticulated cytoplasm, perinuclear halos, raisinoid wrinkled nuclear membranes, binucleation, and absence of conspicuous nucleoli.

A whole slide image of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (KIRC) at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of polygonal tumor cells with abundant optically clear cytoplasm rich in glycogen and lipids, well-defined cell borders, round nuclei with variable nucleolar prominence, and a delicate sinusoidal capillary network surrounding individual tumor nests.

A whole slide image of papillary renal cell carcinoma (KIRP) at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of cuboidal to columnar tumor cells lining true fibrovascular cores, type-1 cells with scant basophilic cytoplasm and small uniform nuclei or type-2 cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and pseudostratified high-grade nuclei, frequent intracellular hemosiderin, and clusters of foamy macrophages within papillary stalks.
